t: Reasons to Love Bagnères-de-Luchon - France Today
s: March 28, 2022 - Known as ‘the Queen of the Pyrénées’, the centre of Luchon is a little slice of Paris. The busy, tree-lined boulevard Allées d’Etigny has restaurants spilling out on to pavements, as well as boulangeries, pâtisseries and chocolatières with the enticing aromas of fresh bread, vanilla and roasting cocoa beans. The town is full of flowers, fountains and gardens and well equipped with shops; you can buy pretty much anything you need in the town.
